FORA Online Toolkit · For sales helpers

Helper guide: Tool 1 → handover → Tool 2

Sit next to the distributor and walk them through the steps below. Open one section at a time.

  1. Tool 1 Market research
  2. Handover Drive link, team, Tool 2
  3. Tool 2 Listing and action plan
Always finalise. At the end of Tool 1 and Tool 2 the distributor must type 1 (Finalise). Without it there is no file, and the next step cannot start.

Tool 1 Market research, from Hi to Finalise 9 steps

  1. Open Tool 1

    Open the Tool 1 link and press Join project. Start a new chat inside the Tool 1 project.

    Check The project name shows above the chat box. A normal chat does not follow the Tool 1 rules.

  2. Say hi

    Type Hi. The AI asks for name, the country to research and the preferred language.

  3. Read the guide, press 0

    The AI makes a step-by-step guide page in their language. When they have read it, type 0.

    Check Make sure the guide page really appeared before pressing 0.

  4. Step 1 · Country and online shopping

    Main marketplaces with sources. Type 1 to continue, or type corrections.

  5. Step 2 · Health products online

    Who pays, where people buy, channel comparison. 1 or corrections.

  6. Step 3 · Choose one product

    Type the number: 1 FORA 6 Connect, 2 FORA 6 Duo, 3 Connect 21 CGM, 4 Blood glucose, 5 Ketone, 6 Total cholesterol, 7 Uric acid.

  7. Step 4 · Selling status and costs

    Already selling this product online? Type 1 and paste the platforms and links. Not yet? Type 2. The AI then shows platform fees and a numbered platform list.

    Check Never give the purchase cost. The AI does not need it.

  8. Finalise: type 1

    The AI creates two files: TOOL1_OUTPUT_….md and TOOL1_FLOW_….html. Download both. Do not rename them.

    Check No download button? Type: Please create the files again as downloads. If the AI pastes code instead, copy all of it and save it under the file name it gives.

  9. More research? (optional)

    1 another product in the same country · 2 another country · 3 finish. Each round makes a new file; take one file at a time to Tool 2.

Handover From Tool 1 to Tool 2 4 steps

  1. Upload the .md file to Drive

    Open TOOL1_FLOW_….html and press Upload my file. Upload the .md file (not the .html), name unchanged.

  2. Copy the file link

    In Google Drive, find the file by name. More actions (three dots) → Share → Copy link.

    Check The distributor cannot see the file in Drive? The helper copies the link. Or skip Drive: in Tool 2, attach the downloaded .md file directly.

  3. Choose your team

    Open the Tool 2 link for the distributor's team.

    TBC Team list and the Tool 2 link for each team.

  4. Join Tool 2

    Press Join project, then start a new chat inside the Tool 2 project.

Tool 2 Listing, from Hi to Finalise 12 steps

How to answer After each step type 1 to continue. To change something, just type it. If the answer is cut short, type 3 Show more.

  1. Hi + the Drive link

    Type Hi and paste the Drive link in the same message. Tool 2 greets them by name and confirms the country and product. No need to answer again.

    Check Link does not open? Paste the content of the .md file, or attach it. Never send the TOOL1_FLOW .html.

  2. T1 · Choose the problem

    1 selling but low sales · 2 not listed yet · 3 open a new platform · 4 beat a competitor · 5 not sure.

  3. T2 · Choose the platform

    Type the number from the Tool 1 platform list (same numbers).

  4. T3 · Product

    Confirm the product card. Test strips are listed together with a FORA meter; CGM is listed as it is.

  5. T4 · Platform research

    How the platform works and what it rewards. Confirm or correct.

  6. T5 · Competitors

    Paste the competitor links they know. The AI adds up to 10; keep at least 5.

  7. T6 · Competitor analysis

    Title length, common words, closest 3–4 side by side. Confirm or correct.

  8. T7 · Answer and price table

    Answer to the chosen problem and what they receive per unit. Type 1 to start the keyword table, or 2 for comments.

  9. T8 · Keyword table

    Words seen on the platform, with counts. Confirm or correct.

  10. T9 · Listing and action plan

    Title, 5 bullets, specs in the local language, and the to-do list. 1 Finalise or 2 edits.

  11. Finalise: type 1

    The AI creates TOOL2_LISTING_….html. Download it and upload it with the form link the AI gives, name unchanged.

    Check No download, but a long block of HTML code? Copy all of it, save it under the file name the AI gives (.html), then upload.

  12. Reply Done

    Type Done after uploading. Or type another platform number to make one more listing (new file).

    Next Open the page together: tick the action plan, press Book a time, and talk about the ad budget.

If stuck Quick fixes 6 tips
  • No option buttons Type the number yourself (0, 1, 2…).
  • Answer cut short Type Show more.
  • AI forgot the rules The chat is outside the project. Start a new chat inside the Tool 1 or Tool 2 project.
  • File name changed Download again and keep the original name; the tools read the name.
  • [TBC] in the answer Normal: the AI marks what it could not verify. It never invents numbers.
  • Asked for purchase cost Do not give it. Type: Skip, not needed.
